verdict.rationale: Browserbase's site claims a fetch capability that converts any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown, which matches getting a page's HTML back. The Skills docs also mention fetching pages. The evidence is a single marketing-level line, though, with no API reference showing a one-call request and response. missing for 10: an API reference or endpoint docs confirming a single-call fetch, confirmation that the returned HTML is raw rather than processed, details on JS rendering or options, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
